This resulted in conflation of "partner" with "spouse" and ignored the prompt's explicit requirement to identify either the current spouse or the most notable ex-spouse. 

This error aligns with **Example 1 (Case #267)** above, where the Planner misinterpreted the task requirement and relied on ambiguous data without reconciling it to determine the historical relationship. The premature conclusion without proper verification led directly to the wrong solution.
